claims.evidence: Program: gen_states.py 53 1 1, `milc ane compile --arch h17`, decoded by my WD parser (WD=<wd>/ori/lay/, trl.py / decode_block_trailers.py). BASE = the u16 tag of the FIRST 0x9344 = __text+0xd4 (file 0x640d4; __text file offset 0x64000). Offsets from BASE, h17: 9344@+0x00 (12B: 44 93 00 3e 00..), 934a@+0x0c, 934a@+0x18, 9442@+0x24 (42 94 80 3d 00 40 0d 00 ..), 1340@+0x30 (40 13 00 22 21 00 00 00), 1341@+0x38, 1440@+0x40 (40 14 00 22 21 00 00 01); trailer ends @+0x48. These are exactly v1's offsets, but they are just cumulative sizes (12,12,12,12,8,8,8) of flat consecutive records: 0x9344 is 12 bytes and the next member starts at +0x0c. The trailer ends exactly at the end of block 0 (block end = __text+0x11c). Only ONE of the 54 0x9344 trailers has this shape; the other 53 are [9344@+0x00, 9442@+0x0c, 1340@+0x18, 1440@+0x20] (end +0x28) and there are 53 more [9442,1440] trailers with no 0x9344 (decode_block_trailers.py: `53x[9442,1440] 53x[9344,9442,1340,1440] 1x[9344,934a,934a,9442,1340,1341,1440]`). Same offsets in N=1,2,10,53 and gen_states.py 53 32 32. Invariant check over 137 compiled programs (2771 blocks, h17+h16g): every trailer is flat, in canonical order, ends exactly at its block end, and no trailer tag occurs outside a trailer; parsed tag totals equal count_desc_records.py in all 20 core programs.
